verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair thing to ask of a SaaS email product, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions any Shortwave SDK or developer library. The MCP material describes Shortwave's assistant connecting out to other MCP servers, which is a client-side integration rather than an SDK. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
